review.assessment: The change replaces `src/eval.rs` with a new implementation that parses multiplicative terms and collects additive operators before combining them. However, the combination phase iterates backward through the operator list and applies each operation to a running result (`terms[k] op result`), which forces right-associative evaluation for all `+` and `-` chains instead of the required left-to-right order. The existing acceptance test passed only because it covers a single subtraction, leaving chained operators untested.

findings.defect: Chained `+`/`-` operators evaluate right-to-left due to reverse iteration in the combination loop.
